source.subject_km: គណិតវិទ្យា
source.description: Preparation exam — function exercise V: f(x) = (x-1)^2/(2(x-2)) — limits, oblique asymptote, position, derivative, tangent, graph.
source.extracted_by: manual transcription from preparation exam (2026-08), answers verified with SymPy

prompt:
We are given the function f(x) = (x-1)^2 / (2(x-2)), with x ≠ 2, and graph (C).
1. Compute lim_{x→2} f(x) and lim_{x→±∞} f(x). Determine the equation of the vertical asymptote of (C).
2. Show that the line (l): y = x/2 is an oblique asymptote of (C). Study the position of (C) relative to (l).
3. Compute f'(x) and build the variation table of f.
4. Draw (C) and its asymptotes.
prompt_latex: \text{គេឱ្យអនុគមន៍ } y=f(x)=\frac{(x-1)^2}{2(x-2)}\ ;\ x\neq 2 \text{ មានក្រាប } (C) .\\ \text{1. គណនា } \lim_{x\to 2} f(x) \text{ និង } \lim_{x\to \pm\infty} f(x) \text{ រួចកំណត់សមីការអាស៊ីមតូតឈរនៃក្រាប } (C) .\\ \text{2. បង្ហាញថាបន្ទាត់ } (l):\ y=\frac{1}{2}x \text{ ជាអាស៊ីមតូតទ្រេតនៃក្រាប } (C) \text{ រួចសិក្សាទីតាំងធៀបរវាងក្រាប } (C) \text{ និង } (l) .\\ \text{3. គណនា } f'(x) \text{ រួចសង់តារាងអថេរភាពនៃ } f .\\ \text{4. សង់ក្រាប } (C) \text{ និងអាស៊ីមតូតរបស់វា។}

parts.question_km: គណនា $\lim_{x\to 2} f(x)$ និង $\lim_{x\to \pm\infty} f(x)$ រួចកំណត់សមីការអាស៊ីមតូតឈរ
parts.technique: As x → 2⁻ the numerator (x-1)² → 1 > 0 while 2(x-2) → 0⁻ so f → -∞; as x → 2⁺, f → +∞ (so x = 2 is the vertical asymptote). f(x) = x/2 + 1/(2(x-2)) behaves like x/2, so f → -∞ at -∞ and +∞ at +∞.

parts.question_km: បង្ហាញថាបន្ទាត់ $(l): y = \frac{1}{2}x$ ជាអាស៊ីមតូតទ្រេត រួចសិក្សាទីតាំងធៀបរវាងក្រាប $(C)$ និង $(l)$
parts.technique: f(x) - x/2 = ((x-1)² - x(x-2))/(2(x-2)) = 1/(2(x-2)) → 0 as x → ±∞, so (l): y = x/2 is the oblique asymptote. The difference is positive exactly when x > 2, so (C) is above (l) on (2, ∞) and below on (-∞, 2).

parts.question_km: គណនា $f'(x)$ រួចសង់តារាងអថេរភាពនៃ $f$
parts.technique: f'(x) = 1/2 - 1/(2(x-2)²) = ((x-2)² - 1)/(2(x-2)²) = (x-1)(x-3)/(2(x-2)²). Critical points x = 1 and x = 3: local maximum at x=1 (f=0), local minimum at x=3 (f=2).

parts.question_km: សង់ក្រាប $(C)$ និងអាស៊ីមតូតរបស់វា
parts.technique: Sketch (C) with the vertical asymptote x = 2, the oblique asymptote y = x/2, the horizontal tangent at x = 3, and the labeled extrema.
